entities.summary: Ivan Mitchell Raimi is an American emergency medicine physician and screenwriter, and an older brother of filmmaker Sam Raimi and actor Ted Raimi. Ivan works as an emergency physician in Chicago, traveling to Los Angeles occasionally to work in Hollywood.
